messages:
emma_mktg: Heads-up: sprint release is scheduled for next week. Need eng + docs alignment for the public post, benchmark callouts, and webinar CTA. Can we lock the rollout window today?

ryan_eng: We can do a staggered rollout: 1-hr smoke -> 2-hr canary -> full. Prefer canary start 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z. End-to-end tests pass on staging.

lila_docs: Docs draft is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499. Changelog draft and migration notes included. Question: do we merge docs before publish or hide via release flag?

theo_product: Merge if possible. If not, include a clear banner in the post pointing to the docs preview URL. Also add a one-liner for Dedicated customers: "contact CS for assisted migration".

casey_sales: For inbound routing we need: HubSpot form link + lead tag. Proposed tag: "mar-release-2026". Also request separate tag for webinar registrants: "mar-release-webinar".

emma_mktg: OK use both tags. We'll append utm_source=benchmark for blog-origin leads. Need the final HubSpot URL and tag payload before we publish social.

ryan_eng: Canary endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/stream-chat. Canary rate: 15rps, ramp to 60rps on success. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 8m or median latency increases > 30%.

lila_docs: Suggested changelog bullets for the announce (short):
```
- Faster cold-starts via improved KV cache warmups
- Optional model pinning for controlled rollouts (config flag required)
- Dynamic batching enhancements for multi-tenant workloads
```
Use docs canonical: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-26

emma_mktg: Draft post copy: "Launching lighter, faster inference: cache warmups, model pinning, smarter batching. See changelog + docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-26. Webinar Thurs 11:00 PT 1 register." Thoughts?

theo_product: Shorten webinar CTA: include time and "deep-dive demos + Q&A". Also ask eng for the bench PNG (median latency graph) for the blog hero.

ryan_eng: I'll export the median-latency-per-model PNG and attach here by EOD today. Perf team confirmed numbers for the blog figures.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z; canary 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z -> 2026-03-26T05:00:00Z; ramp 2026-03-26T06:00:00Z. Rollback if 5xx > 1.5% for 8m OR median latency +30%.

emma_mktg: Final checklist to lock publish: 1) docs canonical URL (lila: confirm), 2) canary endpoints + thresholds (ryan: confirm), 3) HubSpot form + tags (casey: confirm), 4) bench PNG (ryan: pending). If all green, target publish 2026-03-26 15:00 PT.

casey_sales: HubSpot URL: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/mar-release-2026. Tags applied: ["mar-release-2026","mar-release-webinar"]. I'll also add a lead field for "interested_in_dedicated".

lila_docs: Docs PR ready to merge after quick proof at 2026-03-25 22:00 PT. I'll add a clear callout about the model pinning flag so customers aren't surprised.

emma_mktg: Great. If the bench PNG arrives and docs merged, we'll lock the campaign and schedule social + newsletter. Tag this thread with @marketing-alert if anything changes. Thanks all! :rocket:
